import contextlib
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import tempfile

root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
code = runpy.run_path(str(root / 'docs/journeys/journeys.py'))
results = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='journey-review-', dir=root / '.review-runtime') as fixture:
    fixture_root = Path(fixture)
    jdir = fixture_root / 'J99-probe'
    (jdir / 'runs').mkdir(parents=True)
    journey = '---\nid: J99\ntitle: Review fixture\nversion: 1\nstatus: active\nlast_reviewed: 2026-09-22\n---\n### S1 — First step {#S1}\n### S2 — Second step {#S2}\n'
    (jdir / 'journey.md').write_text(journey)
    run = jdir / 'runs/2026-09-22.md'
    valid_prefix = '---\njourney: J99\njourney_version: 1\ncommit: ' + 'a' * 40 + '\ndate: 2026-09-22T10:00Z\nmode: full\ninterface: web-ui\nresult: pass\n'
    cases = [
        ('missing-provenance', '---\njourney: J99\nresult: pass\n---\n'),
        ('contradictory-pass', valid_prefix + 'steps: {S1: fail, S2: pass}\n---\n'),
    ]
    for label, content in cases:
        run.write_text(content)
        buf = io.StringIO()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
            status = code['cmd_lint'](fixture_root)
        results.append({'case': label, 'exit': status, 'output': buf.getvalue().strip()})
    run.write_text(valid_prefix + 'steps: {S1: pass, S2: pass}\n---\n')
    (jdir / 'journey.md').write_text(journey.replace('version: 1', 'version: 2').replace('### S2 — Second step {#S2}\n', '') + '\n## Delta log\n- **Δ2** 2026-09-22 · S2 · behavior-change\n  Retired second step.\n')
    buf = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(buf):
        status = code['cmd_lint'](fixture_root)
    results.append({'case': 'retained-v1-run-after-v2-retirement', 'exit': status, 'output': buf.getvalue().strip()})
assert [item['exit'] for item in results] == [0, 0, 1]
print(json.dumps(results, indent=2))
